name: BTM
recent: BTM Resources Berhad 于2026年11月23日发布截至2026年9月30日止季度的季度报告。公司于2026年10月29日发出第32届常年股东大会通知，会议定于2026年12月2日举行。近期有多项董事会及委员会人事变动，包括审计委员会与提名与薪酬委员会的成员更替。
notable: 将于2026年12月2日举行第32届常年股东大会。
2026年10月28日，Wong See Mei 获委任进入审计委员会及提名与薪酬委员会。
2026年10月5日，Chan Fook Mun 的董事会及审计委员会职务发生变动。
risks: 公司于2026年9月17日更换公司秘书，涉及多名秘书的变动。
最新季度（截至2026年6月30日）净亏损为932.6万令吉，净利率为-485.7%，亏损较上一季度扩大。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日止季度，营收为192万令吉，环比下降28.9%；净亏损为932.6万令吉，净利率为-485.7%，而上一季度净利率为-34.1%。

recent_en: BTM Resources Berhad released its quarterly report for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 23 November 2026. The company issued a notice for its 32nd Annual General Meeting on 29 October 2026, scheduled for 2 December 2026. There were several board and committee changes recently, including changes in the Audit Committee and Nomination and Remuneration Committee.
notable_en: The 32nd Annual General Meeting will be held on 2 December 2026.
On 28 October 2026, Wong See Mei was appointed to the Audit Committee and Nomination and Remuneration Committee.
On 5 October 2026, there was a change in Chan Fook Mun's board and Audit Committee roles.
risks_en: The company changed its company secretary on 17 September 2026, involving multiple secretary changes.
The latest quarter (ended 30 June 2026) recorded a net loss of MYR 9.326 million with a net margin of -485.7%, with losses widening from the previous quarter.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 1.92 million, down 28.9% quarter-on-quarter; net loss was MYR 9.326 million with a net margin of -485.7%, compared to a net margin of -34.1% in the previous quarter.
